Decision 1 in comms/inbox/architect/20261107-1000-architect-A-RT3-go-sentence-form-and-record-freshness.md (F-H3-3). Start only after B-PR840-pin-services-rt832 and B-RT3-g24-ack-rollback-and-exclusive-lock are merged; rebase on them. In preconditions, for a stage with needs_go_sentence, require the go sentence to fullmatch GO STAGE <n> <sha8> (upper-case literals, single spaces, no other text, no newline or control characters) where n equals the stage being run and sha8 equals sha8_of(build_sha) of the run. Refuse with go_sentence_form, go_sentence_stage_mismatch, go_sentence_sha_mismatch (a go sentence with no build sha is already refused live by RT-832-R1). Records keep go_sentence_len and go_sentence_sha8. CLI plan --go-sentence goes through the same check. Update the runbook controller paragraph with the exact form and the honest statement that the controller cannot authenticate who typed it (signing is a Don-only option, not built). Done when: tests for the accepted form and each refusal (go, a single dot, lower case, extra words, trailing newline, wrong stage, wrong sha, no build sha, a 500-char padded form), mutants (any non-empty accepted, stage not compared, sha not compared, fullmatch becomes match, regex allows lower case) die, existing stage_controller tests updated not weakened, CI green, GX10 on the exact head. No estate touched. DON'S DECISION (2026-11-06 chat, recorded in comms/inbox/coordinator/20261107-0010-coordinator-don-answers-signing-soak-ages-stage2-go.md): signing NOT now, the plain GO STAGE <n> <sha8> token bound to the build sha stands; do not build signing. Order: after PR 840, PR 859 and PR 855 merge.

Decision 2 in comms/inbox/architect/20261107-1000-architect-A-RT3-go-sentence-form-and-record-freshness.md (F-H3-4). Start after B-RT3-go-sentence-form merges. In Records: (1) last row per key (kind, gate, sha8) wins for alerts_proven and gate_ok, so a later ok:false row withdraws; (2) estate-fact records expire from the row ts to the moment of the run: alerts_proven 24 h, gate G18 and any Stage 2 window gate 72 h, stage_done read by needs_clean_stage 7 days; gate G21 and G22 rows bound to a sha8 do not expire; constants named in one place; (3) a row with a missing, unparseable or future (over 5 minutes) ts is ignored and counted as ignored_rows in the plan output; (4) new CLI: record withdraw alerts-proven | gate G21|G22|G18 [--build-sha S] appends the ok:false row; (5) plan prints per gate the age of the row it relied on. Use an injectable clock for tests. Do not claim tamper resistance (the module trust statement stays; say so in the runbook). Done when: tests for expiry at the boundary (24h minus 1 s passes, plus 1 s refuses), withdrawal then re-record, future ts, unparseable ts, 2019 back-dated rows with no sha8 refused live, stage_done older than 7 days refuses Stage 3, mutants (no expiry, first row wins, future ts accepted, withdraw ignored, wrong class expiry) die, CI green, GX10 on the exact head. Don-only and not decided in code: the soak minimum and any change of the ages. DON'S DECISION (same file): ages ACCEPTED as written (alerts 24 h, G18 and Stage 2 window gate 72 h, stage_done 7 d, sha-bound G21/G22 never expire); soak minimum stays 1 h per stage, not coded here. Order: after B-RT3-go-sentence-form.
